key_provisions_or_claims: Service robot design lacks sufficient human-centred methodologies to ensure accessibility and acceptance.
Design should be integrated with engineering, psychology and anthropology via co-design with users.
Robot morphology, function and interactive communication determine acceptance.
HERE project will produce quanti/qualitative methods and guidelines for ethical design of social robots.
Telepresence robots in university settings serve as the experimental laboratory.
annotation.summary_en: Design-research paper presenting the HERE project, which develops quantitative and qualitative methods and guidelines for ethical, human-centred design of social service robots. It focuses on telepresence robots in university spaces, stressing morphology, interaction and user acceptance, and multidisciplinary collaboration among design, engineering, psychology and anthropology.
annotation.title_clean: DISEGNARE ROBOT Verso una cultura etica del progetto estetico
annotation.title_en: Designing Robots: Towards an ethical culture of the aesthetic product
